d: The Assistant Manager of Admissions and Student Funding is responsible for the accurate execution of the university’s admissions and student funding processes. The role ensures the timely and accurate processing of applications, supports the administration of scholarships and financial assistance, and provides guidance to prospective and current students and their families. The Assistant Manager works closely with the Senior Manager of Admissions and Student Funding to ensure compliance with university policies, maintain service excellence, support enrollment objectives, and facilitate the effective implementation of admissions and student funding initiatives.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Education, Business Administration, or a related field
3–5 years of experience in admissions, student recruitment, or related higher education roles.
Supervisory or team coordination experience preferred.
Student-focused approach with strong customer service orientation.
Proficiency in data management and admissions systems (e.g., CRM).
Ability to work effectively in a team and cross-departmental environment.
r: Assist in managing day-to-day admissions operations, ensuring timely processing of applications.
Guide prospective students and families through the admissions process with accurate and timely information.
Review applications and support admission decisions in line with university policies.
Support with enrollment events, roadshows and school visits.
Assist in training, supervising, and mentoring admissions staff.
Collaborate with academic and administrative departments in terms of evaluating credit transfer cases as well as special needs cases.
Maintain accurate student records and ensure data integrity in the admissions system.

Coordinate the administration of scholarships, discounts, and student funding schemes, ensuring applications are reviewed and processed in accordance with university policies and eligibility criteria.

Maintain accurate student funding records, monitor scholarship recipients’ eligibility and academic progress, and coordinate with relevant departments to ensure the effective implementation of approved awards
Assist in monitoring scholarship budgets and preparing funding reports, handling student inquiries and appeals, and updating student funding procedures and manuals.
Perform other related duties as reasonably assigned by the Senior management.

d: As a member of the Executive Committee, the Director of Human Resources leads all HR functions and supports the hotel's overall business objectives. This role is responsible for developing and implementing people strategies that promote a positive work culture, associate engagement, and operational excellence.

The Director of Human Resources oversees all aspects of human resources, including recruitment, employee relations, learning and development, performance management, compensation and benefits, and compliance with local labor laws and regulations. The role ensures HR policies and procedures are consistently applied while maintaining a fair and productive workplace.

Working closely with department leaders, the Director of Human Resources supports both short-term and long-term hotel goals by attracting, developing, and retaining talent. The position plays a key role in shaping the associate experience, driving operational effectiveness, and contributing to the overall success of the hotel.
The ideal candidate is a strong people leader with excellent communication skills, a passion for developing talent, and the ability to build positive relationships across all levels of the hotel.
Lead the development and execution of the hotel's Human Resources strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives, brand standards, and the overall vision of the hotel.
Serve as a trusted advisor to the General Manager and Executive Committee on all people-related matters.
Partner with department leaders to drive workforce planning, talent acquisition, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness.
Ensure full compliance with local labor laws, government regulations, and company policies while proactively managing employment-related risks.
Foster a positive, inclusive, and high-performance culture that enhances associate engagement, retention, and productivity.
Oversee recruitment strategies to attract, develop, and retain top talent across all levels of the hotel.
Lead associate relations initiatives, including coaching, performance management, grievance handling, disciplinary matters, and conflict resolution.
Champion learning and development programs that support leadership growth, career progression, and operational excellence.
Monitor key HR metrics, including turnover, engagement, absenteeism, and workforce trends, and implement action plans to improve results.
Collaborate with the Finance team to ensure effective payroll administration, labor cost management, and workforce budgeting.
Drive associate engagement, wellbeing, recognition, and wellness initiatives that support a positive employee experience.
Partner with department leaders to develop future talent pipelines and succession plans for critical roles.
Promote a safe working environment by ensuring compliance with occupational health and safety requirements.
Build and maintain strong relationships with hospitality schools, industry networks, and external partners to support recruitment and employer branding.
Lead and develop the Human Resources team, ensuring high standards of service, professionalism, and continuous improvement.
Support hotel-wide projects and strategic initiatives as required.
Proven experience in a senior Human Resources leadership role within the hospitality industry.
Strong knowledge of UAE labor law, employment practices, and HR compliance requirements.
Exceptional leadership, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to influence and build strong relationships at all levels of the hotel.
Strong business acumen with an understanding of financial and operational drivers.
Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
High level of emotional intelligence and ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment.
Proven track record in talent acquisition, employee engagement, succession planning, and organizational development.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret HR data and drive business decisions.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and HR information systems.
Passion for developing people and creating an outstanding associate experience.
Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, Hotel Management, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years' experience in a senior Human Resources leadership position, preferably within an international hotel environment.
Experience working with HR Local system and HR practices is an advantage.

Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director – Financial Planning to lead financial planning, consolidated reporting, and financial coordination for the Hospitality Business Unit’s development pipeline. Acting as the central financial data resource, the role will provide reliable portfolio insights that support informed decisions on funding, development phasing, and financial performance.

The successful candidate will combine strong financial planning and analysis expertise with practical knowledge of large-scale hospitality development, including hotel financial structures, hotel management agreements, multi-property and multi-category portfolios, hospitality market analysis, FF&E and OS&E budgeting, and pre-opening cost planning. They will work across Development, Finance, Commercial, Procurement, Project Controls, Asset Management, Investment Management, and Hospitality Strategy to maintain a consistent financial source of truth, strengthen forecasting discipline, and proactively identify risks, opportunities, and performance trends
q: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field; a relevant master’s degree or MBA is preferred.
Minimum 10 years of experience in financial management or FP&A, including leadership responsibility in a complex development environment.
Proven experience leading portfolio-wide budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, and consolidated financial reporting.
Strong record of coordinating financial inputs across projects and functions while maintaining a reliable central financial data resource.
Hospitality or large-scale development experience, with an understanding of hotel financial structures and multi-asset portfolios.
Strong commercial judgement with the ability to explain financial performance and advise senior leaders on funding and portfolio decisions.
Demonstrated success leading teams, setting financial controls, and improving reporting consistency and forecasting discipline.
r: Lead annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, and long-range financial planning across the Hospitality Business Unit’s development pipeline.
Own the consolidated financial view of the portfolio, ensuring project and business-unit data is complete, consistent, and current.
Direct monthly reporting and provide senior leadership with clear variance commentary and forward-looking financial insights.
Coordinate financial inputs across projects and corporate functions to align business plans, budgets, forecasts, and funding requirements.
Maintain visibility of capital deployment and portfolio exposure, escalating material risks, opportunities, and funding pressures.
Set financial data definitions, controls, and reporting standards that support a reliable single source of truth.
Lead the Financial Management team and partner with senior stakeholders to strengthen planning discipline and informed decision-making.

Notre travail ne se limite pas à offrir à nos clients un enregistrement et un départ sans problème. Nous devons avant tout bâtir une expérience unique et mémorable. Nos experts en Expérience client prennent l'initiative d'offrir un vaste éventail de services qui guident les clients tout au long de leur séjour. Ils sont habilités à se déplacer dans leur espace et à faire ce qui doit être fait. Que ce soit traiter les besoins opérationnels, répondre aux demandes des clients, préparer des rapports ou partager les points d'intérêt de la région, les experts en Expérience client font en sorte que les clients sentent que les transactions font partie de l'expérience.

Peu importe votre poste, certaines choses sont essentielles pour réussir - la création d'un lieu de travail sécuritaire, le respect des politiques et des procédures de la société, le maintien de la confidentialité, la protection des actifs de la société, le respect des normes de qualité et veiller à ce que votre uniforme, votre apparence personnelle et vos communications soient professionnels. Le rôle d'expert en Expérience client signifie être sur vos pieds et vous déplacer (se lever, s’asseoir ou marcher pendant une longue période de temps) et mettre la main à la pâte dans votre travail (déplacer, soulever, porter, pousser, tirer et placer des objets pesant jusqu’à 10 livres (4,5 kg) sans assistance). Il est essentiel que les experts en Expérience client exécutent toutes ces tâches à la perfection (et toute autre tâche raisonnable qui leur est assignée) - ainsi, nos clients seront toujours satisfaits et notre entreprise continuera de prospérer.
